summary: Combine numeric values into one total.
documentation: sum adds the values of an iterable to a starting value. The default start is zero, which also becomes the result for an empty iterable.
inputs: An iterable of numeric values and an optional starting value.
caution: Use integer cents for exact money totals in this exercise. sum is not intended to concatenate strings.
scenarios: Total invoice amounts stored in cents.
Calculate quantities across several stock locations.
title: Total the account adjustments
problem: Given integer amounts in cents, return their sum. Negative amounts are credits, and an empty list has total 0.
goal: Use sum() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
